projectDescription: PoolProof is an all-in-one pool service management platform that automates routing, scheduling, billing, customer communication, and chemical dosing for pool service businesses.
keyFeatures: Intelligent route optimization with automatic rebalancing and disruption handling
Digital Team Members (AI assistants for communication, routing, billing, and QA)
Automated chemical dosing with validated chemistry algorithms and LSI calculations
Centralized inbox for SMS, WhatsApp, email, and social messages
Automatic invoicing, ACH/card collections, and QuickBooks Online sync
Customer self-serve portal with service history, invoices, and payments
Self-serve online signup with service area validation and digital agreements
Process management with phased workflows (Before / During / After)
Service plans and areas with configurable pricing, chemical protocols, and maintenance schedules
Quoting and work orders with smart scheduling, conflict detection, and electronic approvals
Issue tracking with AI-powered intake and work order linkage
Fleet management with mileage tracking and preventive maintenance scheduling
Built-in email marketing with segmentation and drag-and-drop editor
Role-based access control with 60+ capabilities and Google/Microsoft SSO
White-glove onboarding and done-for-you data migration
publicApiSurface: Customer portal (self-service invoices, payments, service history)
Self-serve signup page (embeddable URL for websites)
QuickBooks Online integration (invoice, payment, refund, tax sync)
SMS, WhatsApp, email, Facebook message inbox
Automated chemical dosing engine (free chlorine, pH, alkalinity, CYA, LSI)
Role-based access control (Owner, Administrator, Regional Manager, Sales, Service Technician, custom roles)
